title: Gladys Reyes reunites with original 'Mara Clara' cast in MV for single 'Primera Kontrabida'
summary: Actress Gladys Reyes expressed gratitude as she officially launched the music video for her debut single, “Primera Kontrabida,” a project she described as an answered prayer.
